# MapScrape API documentation

MapScrape is a central scraping service. Consumer applications call it over HTTPS; they must not clone this repository, install Puppeteer, run a second scraper, or access the central database directly.

## Start here
- Public developer portal: https://mapscrape-v2.vercel.app/docs/
- REST API v1 contract: https://mapscrape-v2.vercel.app/openapi.yaml
- API health: https://mapscrape-v2.vercel.app/api/v1/health
- API reference in source: https://github.com/Tokenizaa/mapscrape-v2/blob/main/docs/API.md
- Agent integration prompt: https://mapscrape-v2.vercel.app/docs/#agent-prompt

## Consumer configuration
- MAPSCRAPE_API_BASE_URL: confirmed deployed API base URL.
- MAPSCRAPE_API_KEY: individual consumer credential stored only as a server-side secret.

Never expose API keys in browser code, URLs, logs, prompts, or version control. Do not give the administrative MAPSCRAPE_PROVISIONING_TOKEN to consumer agents. If a credential is missing, an authorized operator must provision it and store it directly in the consumer secret manager.

## Main endpoints
- GET /api/v1/health
- GET /api/v1/leads
- GET /api/v1/leads/{id}
- POST /api/v1/jobs
- GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}
- GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/results

Authenticated endpoints use Authorization: Bearer <MAPSCRAPE_API_KEY>. Individual credentials are scoped to the consumer project. Jobs are asynchronous; create a job, poll status, then retrieve paginated results.

## Agent requirements
Read the public portal and OpenAPI contract before implementing. Adapt the existing consumer architecture, write tests, run lint/typecheck/build, and distinguish mocked tests from real API validation. Never clone or embed MapScrape in the consumer project.
